purpose: 运行各侧交付的真实示例，保存允许决策的归档及独立检查点，并显示产品给出的接续命令。
output:
online decision: allowed=true reason="matched allow policy" matched=[p-ledger-read-2026] policy version=1
published policy became version 1

materials saved:
  archive:    acme-factory.audit (778 bytes, 2 records)
  checkpoint: acme-factory.checkpoint  [kept separately]

separately retained checkpoint:
  org:         "acme factory"
  end-seq:     2
  fingerprint: 04b274dbb4cf039bbb4b78f5ee5aae03278d2c34833fe87fecb13ade51ef5299

Now run (the Store and the original request are gone; the review reads
only the saved materials and never re-submits the request):

  go run ./cmd/darksafe review \
    --archive acme-factory.audit \
    --org 'acme factory' \
    --seq 2 \
    --end-seq 2 \
    --fingerprint 04b274dbb4cf039bbb4b78f5ee5aae03278d2c34833fe87fecb13ade51ef5299

Two ways to pick the wrong material:

  (a) --seq 1 instead of 2: it points at the policy publish record,
      which is not a decision; review exits 1 with a distinguishable
      error on stderr and prints nothing on stdout.

  (b) a fingerprint that does not match the archive: same exit code 1,
      same stderr-only, no partial review.

purpose: 显示真实帮助中的材料示例，观察其归档、序号和指纹是否对应刚生成的材料。
output:
usage: darksafe review --archive FILE --org ORG --seq N \
                      --end-seq N --fingerprint HEX

Review one access decision saved in an audit archive, long after the
service instance that made the decision has ended. No running service is
contacted and no policy store is created or restored; the decision is
recomputed offline from the archived material alone. The archived decision
is never re-submitted as a new access request.

Required inputs:
  --archive FILE       path to the audit archive written by
                       EncodeAuditArchive (the complete export, not a
                       subject-filtered page or a fragment)
  --org ORG            organization name the archive belongs to; it must
                       match the organization bound into the records
  --seq N              positive sequence number of the decision record to
                       review (organization-local, starting at 1)
  --end-seq N          end sequence of the checkpoint retained separately
                       from the archive (0 for an organization with no
                       records); must not be negative
  --fingerprint HEX    checkpoint fingerprint retained separately from the
                       archive (64 hexadecimal SHA-256 characters)

The checkpoint carried inside the archive is informational only: validation
always uses --end-seq/--fingerprint supplied here. Even when --seq points at
an early record, every archived record is checked; a corrupted or missing
later record, or any mismatch with the retained checkpoint, fails the whole
review with no partial output.

The request is replayed strictly against the policy version the recorded
decision actually used; later publishes or rollbacks present in the archive
are never substituted. A chain that is valid but whose original and
recomputed decisions disagree is still printed in full and exits 0; the
disagreement is shown explicitly rather than reported as file damage.

Strings may contain spaces, control characters or non-UTF-8 bytes; output
quoting keeps different raw bytes distinguishable. This command only reads
the named archive: it neither rewrites it nor appends audit records.

Exit codes: 0 review complete (decisions may disagree), 1 archive or target
invalid / historical version unavailable, 2 bad arguments or unreadable
file.

Example:
  (materials produced by examples/offline_review; seq 1 is the
  policy publish record, seq 2 is the read decision being reviewed)
  darksafe review --archive acme-factory.audit \
      --org 'acme factory' --seq 2 --end-seq 2 \
      --fingerprint 04b274dbb4cf039bbb4b78f5ee5aae03278d2c34833fe87fecb13ade51ef5299

purpose: 生成进程结束后，读取独立检查点文件完成复核，显示双方允许、命中策略、版本 1 和一致结论。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive acme-*.audit --org "$(cat review-organization.txt)" --seq 2 --end-seq 2 --fingerprint "$(sed 's/.*[= ]//' acme-*.checkpoint | tail -n 1)"
output:
target sequence: 2
original decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
recomputed decision:
  allowed: true
  reason: "matched allow policy"
  matched policies: ["p-ledger-read-2026"]
  policy version: 1
consistent: yes

purpose: 用同一份真实材料把目标改为发布记录，保留非决策错误及 Go 运行器的真实失败输出。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive acme-*.audit --org "$(cat review-organization.txt)" --seq 1 --end-seq 2 --fingerprint "$(sed 's/.*[= ]//' acme-*.checkpoint | tail -n 1)"
output:
review: darksafe: audit record is not a decision: sequence 1 is policy_change
exit status 1

purpose: 提供不匹配的外部指纹，显示与非决策目标可区分的校验失败，且不产生部分复核结果。
command: go run ./cmd/darksafe review --archive acme-*.audit --org "$(cat review-organization.txt)" --seq 2 --end-seq 2 --fingerprint "$(cat mismatched.checkpoint)"
output:
review: archive validation failed: darksafe: invalid audit range: embedded checkpoint does not match the retained checkpoint
exit status 1
